# Cursor movement. Default size 10x5; positions are 1-based ROW,COL.

=== CUP with no parameters homes the cursor
source: esctest2 cup.py test_CUP_DefaultParams
input: abc\e[3;4H\e[H
cursor: 1,1

=== CUP moves to row and column
source: esctest2 cup.py test_CUP_RowOnly, test_CUP_ColumnOnly
input: \e[3;4H
cursor: 3,4

=== CUP with an empty row parameter uses row 1
source: esctest2 cup.py test_CUP_ColumnOnly
input: \e[4;4H\e[;5H
cursor: 1,5

=== CUP clamps to the screen
source: esctest2 cup.py test_CUP_OutOfBoundsParams
input: \e[99;99H
cursor: 5,10

=== CUP with zero parameters means one
source: esctest2 cup.py test_CUP_ZeroIsTreatedAsOne
input: \e[3;3H\e[0;0H
cursor: 1,1

=== HVP is CUP
source: esctest2 hvp.py test_HVP_RowOnly, test_HVP_OutOfBoundsParams
input: \e[2;5f
cursor: 2,5

=== CUU stops at the top
source: esctest2 cuu.py test_CUU_StopsAtTopLine
input: \e[3;3H\e[9A
cursor: 1,3

=== CUU of zero moves one row
source: esctest2 cuu.py test_CUU_DefaultParam
input: \e[3;3H\e[0A
cursor: 2,3

=== CUU stops at the top margin when it starts inside the region
source: esctest2 cuu.py test_CUU_StopsAtTopMarginInScrollRegion
input: \e[2;4r\e[3;1H\e[9A
cursor: 2,1

=== CUU above the region goes to the top line
source: esctest2 cuu.py test_CUU_StopsAtTopLineWhenBegunAboveScrollRegion
input: \e[3;4r\e[2;1H\e[9A
cursor: 1,1

=== CUD stops at the bottom
source: esctest2 cud.py test_CUD_StopsAtBottomLine
input: \e[9B
cursor: 5,1

=== CUD stops at the bottom margin when it starts inside the region
source: esctest2 cud.py test_CUD_StopsAtBottomMarginInScrollRegion
input: \e[2;3r\e[2;1H\e[9B
cursor: 3,1

=== CUD below the region goes to the bottom line
source: esctest2 cud.py test_CUD_StopsAtBottomLineWhenBegunBelowScrollRegion
input: \e[2;3r\e[4;1H\e[9B
cursor: 5,1

=== CUF stops at the right edge
source: esctest2 cuf.py test_CUF_StopsAtRightSide
input: \e[99C
cursor: 1,10

=== CUF defaults to one
source: esctest2 cuf.py test_CUF_DefaultParam
input: \e[1;3H\e[C
cursor: 1,4

=== CUB stops at the left edge
source: esctest2 cub.py test_CUB_StopsAtLeftEdge
input: \e[1;5H\e[99D
cursor: 1,1

=== CUB defaults to one
source: esctest2 cub.py test_CUB_DefaultParam
input: \e[1;5H\e[D
cursor: 1,4

=== CHA moves within the row
source: esctest2 cha.py test_CHA_ExplicitParam
input: \e[2;2H\e[7G
cursor: 2,7

=== CHA clamps to the right edge
source: esctest2 cha.py test_CHA_OutOfBoundsLarge
input: \e[99G
cursor: 1,10

=== CHA with zero goes to column one
source: esctest2 cha.py test_CHA_ZeroParam
input: \e[1;5H\e[0G
cursor: 1,1

=== HPA is CHA
source: esctest2 hpa.py test_HPA_DoesNotChangeRow
input: \e[3;2H\e[4`
cursor: 3,4

=== VPA moves within the column
source: esctest2 vpa.py test_VPA_DoesNotChangeColumn
input: \e[1;3H\e[4d
cursor: 4,3

=== VPA clamps to the bottom
source: esctest2 vpa.py test_VPA_StopsAtBottomEdge
input: \e[1;3H\e[99d
cursor: 5,3

=== CNL moves down to column one
source: esctest2 cnl.py test_CNL_ExplicitParam
input: \e[1;5H\e[2E
cursor: 3,1

=== CNL stops at the bottom
source: esctest2 cnl.py test_CNL_StopsAtBottomLine
input: \e[1;5H\e[99E
cursor: 5,1

=== CPL moves up to column one
source: esctest2 cpl.py test_CPL_ExplicitParam
input: \e[4;5H\e[2F
cursor: 2,1

=== CPL stops at the top
source: esctest2 cpl.py test_CPL_StopsAtTopLine
input: \e[4;5H\e[99F
cursor: 1,1

=== HPR moves right
source: esctest2 hpr.py test_HPR_DoesNotChangeRow
input: \e[1;2H\e[3a
cursor: 1,5

=== HPR clamps to the right edge
source: esctest2 hpr.py test_HPR_StopsAtRightEdge
input: \e[1;2H\e[99a
cursor: 1,10

=== VPR moves down
source: esctest2 vpr.py test_VPR_DoesNotChangeColumn
input: \e[1;2H\e[3e
cursor: 4,2

=== VPR clamps to the bottom
source: esctest2 vpr.py test_VPR_StopsAtBottomEdge
input: \e[1;2H\e[99e
cursor: 5,2

=== BS moves one column left
source: esctest2 bs.py test_BS_Basic
input: abc\b
cursor: 1,3

=== BS stops at the left edge
source: esctest2 bs.py test_BS_NoWrapByDefault
input: \e[2;1H\b\b
cursor: 2,1

=== CR returns to column one
source: esctest2 cr.py test_CR_Basic
input: abc\r
cursor: 1,1

=== LF keeps the column
source: esctest2 lf.py test_LF_Basic
input: ab\n
cursor: 2,3

=== VT and FF act as LF
source: xterm ctlseqs, C0 controls (VT and FF are treated as LF)
input: a\x0b\x0c
cursor: 3,2

=== A cursor move clears the pending wrap
source: vttest menu 1 (autowrap), xterm ctlseqs DECAWM
input: 0123456789\e[1;10H
cursor: 1,10
